value.rationale: A classical and unusually torsion-bearing finite matching complex has a natural fourteen-element full symmetry group. Unlike the known sevenfold rotation quotient with order-21 first homology, the full-dihedral orbit is simply connected and spherical. An explicit geometric collapse gives complete homotopy type, not merely ranks or a tautological group substitution, and makes the comparison mathematically useful.
